faq.a: arshia.wav is a Dubai-based DJ who plays regular nights at Moe's on the 5th and Soho Garden. His sets are open format: house, afro house, hip-hop and R&B, mixed live for the room.

faq.q: Where does arshia.wav play in Dubai?
faq.a: Mainly at Moe's on the 5th, the rooftop venue on the 5th floor of the Sheraton Grand Hotel on Sheikh Zayed Road, and at Soho Garden at Meydan Racecourse. Upcoming dates are listed on the Events page.

faq.q: How do I get on arshia.wav's guest list?
faq.a: Use the guest list form on this site or message the WhatsApp number on the Guest List page with your name, Instagram handle, the date and how many people. You'll get a confirmation before the night.
Yes. Both venues run a smart dress code: no sportswear, shorts, flip-flops or caps. Soho Garden is 21+. Arrive early for guaranteed entry on guest list.
Open format built around house and afro house, with hip-hop and R&B drops and latin edits depending on the room and the hour.

faq.q: How do I book arshia.wav for a private event or brand activation?
faq.a: Email the bookings address on the Press page or DM @arshia.wav on Instagram with the date, venue and set length.
